description_en: Lists the subscription relationships for a consumer group
description_zh: 查询消费组订阅关系列表
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq list-consumer-group-subscriptions --instance-id rmq-cn-tl32wwz1r05 --consumer-group-id PRINT_RETRY_CONSUMER --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConsumerGroupSubscriptions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 RocketMQ 版的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer group whose subscription relationships you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 消费者分组ID，表示需要查询哪个消费者分组的订阅关系
parameters.name: consumer_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the topic. If you do not specify this parameter, all subscription relationships are queried
parameters.help_zh: 主题名称，不填则查询所有订阅关系
parameters.name: topic_name

items.description_en: The list of subscription relationships for the consumer group
items.description_zh: 消费者组订阅关系列表

consistency.description_en:
The consistency of the subscription relationship.

false: The subscription relationship is inconsistent.

true: The subscription relationship is consistent
consistency.description_zh:
订阅关系的一致性。
订阅关系不一致为false。
订阅关系一致为true

consumerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the consumer group

filterExpressionType.description_en:
The type of the filter expression.

SQL: SQL filtering.

TAG: Tag filtering
filterExpressionType.description_zh:
过滤表达式类型。
SQL：SQL过滤
TAG：Tag过滤
filterExpressionType.title_en: 过滤表达式类型,SubscriptionExpressionTypeEnum[SQL(SQL过滤),TAG(TAG过滤),UNSPECIFIED(FILTER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED  过滤类型未指定),code,desc]
filterExpressionType.title_zh: 过滤表达式类型,SubscriptionExpressionTypeEnum[SQL(SQL过滤),TAG(TAG过滤),UNSPECIFIED(FILTER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED  过滤类型未指定),code,desc]

messageModel.description_en:
The consumption mode of the consumer group.

BROADCASTING: The broadcast consumption mode.

CLUSTERING: The cluster consumption mode
messageModel.description_zh:
消费者分组的消费模式。
BROADCASTING：广播模式
CLUSTERING：集群模式
messageModel.title_en: 消费模式,ConsumptionModelEnum[BROADCASTING(广播模式),CLUSTERING(集群模式),code,desc]
messageModel.title_zh: 消费模式,ConsumptionModelEnum[BROADCASTING(广播模式),CLUSTERING(集群模式),code,desc]

subscriptionStatus.description_en:
The subscription status.

ONLINE: The consumer group is online. If a consumer group contains multiple consumers, the group is considered online as long as at least one consumer is online.

OFFLINE: The consumer group is offline. If a consumer group contains multiple consumers, the group is considered offline only when all consumers are offline
subscriptionStatus.description_zh:
订阅状态。
ONLINE：在线。消费者分组下如果有多个消费者，只要有一个消费者在线则显订阅状态为在线。
OFFLINE：离线。消费者分组下如果有多个消费者，所有消费者都处于离线时订阅状态才显示离线

topicCreated.description_en: Indicates whether the topic is created

topicName.description_en: The topic to which the consumer group subscribes
topicName.description_zh: 指定消费者分组订阅的主题
